title: TrustLens Rule Evaluation Result (DET-001 design contract)
description: Phase 3 DET-001 / ADR-0005. The structured result of evaluating ONE published rule against one submission's indicator observations. DESIGN CONTRACT — it fixes the shape of a per-rule result so the deterministic engine (a later phase) is built to it; it does not itself run. Distinct from the Phase-2 rule_runner, which computes only MATCHED/severity over a declared, closed-world signal set. The critical additions here are (a) a three-valued required_combination_result (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN) so an UNKNOWN required indicator yields INDETERMINATE rather than NOT_MATCHED, and (b) the separation of rule_evidence_verdict, effective_severity and rule_confidence as independent quantities (CONF-001). No numeric risk/probability appears anywhere.

evaluation_state.description: MATCHED: require evaluated TRUE and evidence-class diversity met. NOT_MATCHED: require evaluated FALSE. INDETERMINATE: require evaluated UNKNOWN (a decisive operand is UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS) — carries uncertainty forward rather than collapsing to benign (STEP 7). SUPPRESSED: matched then cancelled by an override-aware SUPPRESS_RULE. NOT_APPLICABLE: language_scope excludes the input, rule not PUBLISHED, or a per-rule evaluation error (degraded).

required_combination_result.description: Kleene three-valued evaluation of logic.require. OBSERVED->TRUE; NOT_OBSERVED/NOT_APPLICABLE->FALSE; UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS->UNKNOWN. all_of: FALSE if any FALSE, TRUE if all TRUE, else UNKNOWN. any_of: TRUE if any TRUE, FALSE if all FALSE, else UNKNOWN. n_of(n): TRUE if TRUE-count>=n, FALSE if TRUE+UNKNOWN < n, else UNKNOWN.

matched_positive_indicators.description: Positive indicators OBSERVED (extraction confidence >= gate) that satisfied require branches.

neutralised_indicators.description: Positive indicators removed by directional SUPPRESS_INDICATOR before evaluation (not override-blockable).

evidence_classes_spanned.description: Distinct parent_evidence_class values among the TRUE operands. Its size must be >= min_evidence_classes_required for a MATCH (CONF-002).

suppression.description: How suppression acted on this rule (STEP 11).

suppressed_by.description: Negative-indicator id or SUPPRESSION rule id that cancelled the finding, if any.

blocked_suppressors.description: Suppressors that WOULD have applied but were blocked by an active hard-risk override; recorded as explanation (FR-042).

active_overrides.description: Hard-risk overrides active for this rule. Active only when their decisive indicators are OBSERVED at >= the extraction-confidence gate (STEP 8/10). Overrides gate suppression; they never set severity nor bypass require (STEP 10).

extraction_confidence_inputs.description: Per decisive indicator, the extraction confidence that fed the confidence gate. Keys are indicator ids. Never multiplied (STEP 8).

rule_evidence_verdict.description: Carried from the rule's evidence.verdict. PARTIAL/HEURISTIC cap rule_confidence at MEDIUM and (via severity_cap) cap severity — the mechanism by which evidence quality changes behaviour (RESEARCH-004 section 7).

effective_severity.description: min(rule_severity_declared, evidence.severity_cap, any CAP_SEVERITY). Ordinal; not a number.

rule_confidence.description: Per-rule detection confidence (STEP 9) — completeness of require, extraction confidence of decisive indicators, independent-class corroboration within the rule, evidence verdict, ambiguity. NOT a probability.

explanation_fragment.description: Sourced from the rule's explanation object; runtime facts are interpolated, never invented.

source_references.description: The rule's evidence.source_references, echoed so the decision is self-contained and citations are auditable. The explanation may assert an official fact ONLY if it appears here as a quote (DET-001 explanation-provenance constraint).
